current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application forms and checklists' page links this PDF as 'Wirral Local Validation requirements (PDF, 304KB)' under the heading 'Development Management Validation Checklist May 2025', and the PDF says 'Adopted May 2025'; no newer list or consultation is mentioned.

issues.detail: All 8 tab_items were scraped from the forms-and-checklists web page, not the checklist, and are mostly link text, fees and boilerplate: 'Householder Development Notice No.1 (PDF) ... Fee You need to pay a fee', the validation check service fee (major £300 / other £150), 'Social Value guidance (PDF...) Privacy Notice We care about your privacy', 'Pay for your validation check Administration fee for applications returned invalid', and 'Adoptable residential roads specification (PDF)'. Three real requirements (Social Value Statement for majors, HIA under Policy WD18, Heritage Statement) are buried in link text, not captured as items.
issues.evidence: tab_items source = planning-application-forms-and-checklists page; none taken from the 57-item checklist PDF

issues.detail: About 25 of the checklist's 57 items are missing from the app-type rows: 1 3D Model (tall buildings, 8+ storeys); 2 3D Visualisations (major new-build; non-householder new buildings affecting heritage assets or their settings); 6 Agricultural/Rural Worker Needs Assessment (only present with the wrong trigger); 7 Air Quality Assessment; 14 Digital Connectivity Statement (new dwellings or business premises); 16 Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (all majors; minor/householder near designated sites, habitat loss, mature trees, demolition or significant roof alteration); 19 Energy Statement (non-householder new buildings; Birkenhead Heat Network area); 22 Flood Risk Assessment (FZ2/3; FZ1 1ha+); 23 Flues and Mechanical Extract (hot-food takeaways, cooked-food uses); 24 Geological Impact Assessment (Local Geological Sites); 28 Historic Environment Impact Assessment; 30 Landfill Gas Risk Assessment (new buildings or ground-floor extensions within 250m of landfill); 31 Draft Landscape Plans (all majors); 35 Marketing Statement – Employment Uses (Primarily Employment Areas); 36 Masterplan Compliance Statement; 38 Minerals Assessment (Minerals Safeguarding Area); 39 Nature Improvement Area Statement (NIA Focus Areas 1-7); 40 Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment; 42 Photographic Survey (listed buildings, LBC, local-list assets, new buildings in conservation areas); 49 Social Value Statement incl. Employment and Skills Plan (all majors); 50 Specialist Housing Needs Assessment; 51 Statement of Community Involvement (all majors); 52 Structural Survey (re-use of Green Belt buildings); 53 Townscape and Visual Impact Assessment (tall buildings); 57 Waste Management Assessment. The Design and Access Statement (11: all majors, conservation area/WHS dwellings and 100 sqm+) appears only under Listed building consent.

The Householder rows (Land Contamination Assessment, Roof plan, Waste/Refuse storage) were placed there because the text contains 'householder', but each source trigger explicitly excludes householder applications. The Householder requirements the checklist does give were left out: tree screening via the site plan (8), PEA for householder schemes near designated sites, mature trees, demolition or roof alteration (16), HEIA (28), and plans/elevations for all applications.
issues.evidence: 29: 'Any application (except householder applications) ...'; 45: 'All applications (except householder applications) where refuse and recycling storage will be required'

issues.detail: Many triggers are copied from the neighbouring item. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' quotes the item 14 Digital Connectivity trigger (new dwellings or business premises); item 15 actually says all major applications. 'Fire Statement' quotes the EIA Schedule 1 trigger; the real trigger is relevant buildings 18m+ or 7+ storeys with 2+ dwellings or student accommodation, with outline and s73 exempt. 'Viability Assessment' and 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' both quote the item 5 Agricultural Land Classification trigger. 'Planning Statement' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' quote the Accessible Housing text; the source says Planning Statement for all majors plus minor/other development in the Green Belt, and floor/elevation drawings for all applications. 'Archaeological Assessment' runs into the item 10 BNG trigger.
issues.evidence: 15 Drainage Strategy: 'All major applications'; 43 Planning Statement: 'All major applications, and minor or other development within the Green Belt'; 56 Viability Appraisal: '...cannot meet a policy compliant level of affordable housing...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are fragments or content descriptions, not when the item is needed. 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment' and 'Block plan / Site plan' are both just 'requirement for Arboricultural 1.'; the source says works where trees could be affected, and site plans for all applications. 'Crime prevention' describes Secured by Design content; the source says all major applications. 'LVIA' quotes the GLVIA competence sentence; the source says majors in Areas of Special Landscape Value or Green Belt, and all wind turbines. 'Health Impact Assessment' quotes the web page ('bespoke HIA ... case-by-case'); the source says 10+ dwellings, 1,000 sqm+ non-residential, hot-food takeaways, pubs, education, health and community facilities. 'Transport Assessment', 'Travel Plan' and 'Telecommunications' are content text. 'Existing and proposed site levels' is drawing-standards text; the source says new or replacement buildings, or level changes of 1m+. 'Design Code' merges the item 13 heading and drops the 4ha, 10,000 sqm and 2ha thresholds.
issues.evidence: 12 Design Code: '200+ dwellings (or 4ha+ ...), or other development of 10,000 sqm+ floorspace or 2ha+'; 47 Section Drawings: 'level changes of 1m or more'

issues.detail: 'Photographs / Photomontages' under Full planning is PEA screening text running into the item 17 Electronic Communications heading; the actual 42 Photographic Survey (heritage works) is not captured. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' under Listed building consent is a garbled mix of item 2 3D Visualisations and item 3 Accessible Housing; the checklist has no pre-application requirement. 'Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing' is not a separate item; it is part of the item 37 Microclimate Assessment content for tall buildings.
issues.evidence: Photographs excerpt: '...whether a PEA is required. 17 Electronic Communications Development Evidence Statement ...'

issues.detail: About 30 requirements are flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Affordable Housing, BNG, HRA, Gypsy & Traveller, S106, Tall buildings) and summarised in one issue. Some also apply to other types the workbook marks '(none)': for Listed building consent, the 42 Photographic Survey and 28 HEIA, as well as the DAS. Item 21 says the Fire Statement does not apply to outline or s73 applications.
issues.evidence: 42 Photographic Survey: 'Listed Building Consent applications ... new buildings in conservation areas'

issues.detail: Several rows share the same trigger excerpt: 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' and 'Agricultural Land Classification'; 'Roof plan' and 'Waste / Refuse'; 'Environmental Statement' and 'Fire Statement'; 'Arboricultural' and 'Block plan / Site plan'; and 'Floor plans', 'Housing mix' and 'Planning Statement' (Accessible Housing text). 'Design Code' is listed under both Full planning and Outline with the same garbled trigger.
The source gives a month only ('Adopted May 2025'), but the workbook records 2025-05-01 as if that day were known. The month is correct.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Wirral checklist (adopted May 2025, linked from the forms-and-checklists page). Its tab items come from the web page (fees, links, privacy notice), not the 57-item checklist. About 25 requirements are missing, many triggers belong to the neighbouring item, and the three Householder rows are requirements that explicitly exclude householder applications.
